bodies: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)

exams.name: NCCCO Articulating Crane Operator (AC)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of knuckle-boom articulating cranes mounted on service and delivery trucks.

exams.name: NCCCO Crane Inspector (MCI/TCI/OCI)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of mobile, tower and overhead cranes for structural and mechanical compliance.

exams.name: NCCCO Digger Derrick Operator (DD)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of digger derricks used for pole setting and material handling by utility crews.

exams.name: NCCCO Lattice Boom Crane Operator (LBC/LBT)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of lattice boom crawlers and truck cranes for heavy lift and infrastructure work.

exams.name: NCCCO Lift Director (MLD/TLD)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies planning and supervision of critical lifts, including engineering and on-site coordination.

exams.name: NCCCO Mobile Crane Operator (TLL/TSS)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of lattice and telescopic boom trucks and crawlers through written and practical exams.

exams.name: NCCCO Overhead Crane Operator (OC)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of bridge and gantry overhead cranes in factories, yards and shipping facilities.

exams.name: NCCCO Rigger Level I
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies basic rigging of loads using hitch selection, slings and hardware under a qualified signalperson.

exams.name: NCCCO Rigger Level II
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies advanced rigging including critical lift planning, load calculations and supervision of rigging crews.

exams.name: NCCCO Service Truck Crane Operator (STC)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of small service truck cranes for field repair and light lifting duties.

exams.name: NCCCO Signalperson
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies crane signalpersons in hand and voice signals directing lifts under OSHA crane standards.

exams.name: NCCCO Telehandler Operator (TH)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of variable reach forklifts (telehandlers) for material placement on job sites.

exams.name: NCCCO Tower Crane Operator (TWR)
exams.body: National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators (NCCCO)
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of tower cranes used in high-rise and vertical construction through written and practical tests.

exams.name: ASNT ACCP Professional Level II
exams.blurb: Personnel qualification under the ASNT Central Certification Programme for independent, portable NDT certification at Level II.

exams.name: ASNT ACCP Professional Level III
exams.blurb: Top-tier independent NDT certification under the ASNT Central Certification Programme covering method and programme management.

exams.name: ASNT Eddy Current Testing (ET)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in electromagnetic testing for surface and near-surface crack detection on conductive materials.

exams.name: ASNT Industrial Radiography Radiation Safety Personnel (IRRSP)
exams.blurb: Certifies radiation safety knowledge for personnel operating industrial radiographic equipment and handling sealed sources.

exams.name: ASNT Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in liquid penetrant inspection for locating surface-breaking flaws on non-porous materials.

exams.name: ASNT Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in magnetic particle inspection for detecting surface and near-surface flaws in ferrous parts.

exams.name: ASNT NDT Level I
exams.blurb: Qualifies technicians to perform specific NDT tests under supervision and record results per documented procedures.

exams.name: ASNT NDT Level II
exams.blurb: Qualifies technicians to set up and conduct tests, interpret codes and supervise Level I personnel within certified methods.

exams.name: ASNT NDT Level III
exams.blurb: Senior credential qualifying holders to establish NDT techniques, interpret standards and direct full inspection programmes.

exams.name: ASNT Radiographic Testing (RT)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in radiographic inspection using X-ray or gamma sources to image internal weld and casting flaws.

exams.name: ASNT Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in ultrasonic inspection for thickness measurement and flaw detection using high-frequency sound.

exams.name: ASNT Visual Testing (VT)
exams.blurb: Method-specific certification in visual inspection, the most common NDT method for weld, casting and component evaluation.

exams.name: API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of in-service pressure vessels in refineries and chemical plants under API inspection codes.

exams.name: API 570 Piping Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of in-service process piping systems, covering inspection, repair and remaining-life assessment.

exams.name: API 653 Aboveground Storage Tank Inspector
exams.blurb: Certifies inspectors of in-service aboveground storage tanks, covering bottom, shell, roof and foundation inspection.

exams.name: ISO 9712 NDT Personnel Certification
exams.blurb: International standard for qualifying and certifying NDT personnel across methods, used by accredited bodies worldwide.

exams.name: NAS 410 NDT Personnel Approval
exams.blurb: Aerospace NDT personnel approval standard used by defence and aviation primes to qualify inspection personnel.

exams.name: ACPA Certified Concrete Pump Operator
exams.blurb: Certifies operators of boom and line concrete pumps in safe setup, placing and cleanup of pumped concrete.

exams.name: Aerial Lift / MEWP Operator
exams.blurb: Certifies safe operation of scissor and boom lifts (MEWPs) under ANSI A92 and employer training standards.

exams.name: EPA Section 608 Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Federally mandated certification for anyone who maintains, services or disposes of equipment containing regulated refrigerants.
